summary: Iter 16 — Admin Founders dashboard + Voice permission primer + regressions. Backend: 5/5 pytest passing (GET /api/admin/founders/codes returns 61 codes incl. FOUNDER01..FOUNDER60 + JOIN, at least one redeemed; anon → 401; /api/voice/intent 'go to my profile' → navigate=/profile; /api/voice/query/todays_highlights returns {crossings, messages, views, summary}). Frontend (Playwright, admin login hiagainxyz): /admin/founders mounts [data-testid=admin-founders-page] with 61 rows; filter tabs all/redeemed/unclaimed present; Redeemed filter shows exactly 1 row (FOUNDER01), Unclaimed shows 60 (FOUNDER01 hidden); search 'FOUNDER05' narrows to 1 row; copy button triggers 'Share link copied' toast; refresh re-fetches; voice primer flow on /feed — first tap opens [data-testid=voice-permission-primer], cancel does NOT set localStorage flag and primer re-opens on next tap, accept sets 'hiagain.voice_primer_accepted'='1'; voice-fab visible on /feed and /discover, hidden on /login when logged out. Morning greeting effect verified via code inspection in VoiceAssistant.js lines 271-306: gated on user && primer accepted && local hour 5-11 && last_greeting_date !== today, sets last_greeting_date to today ISO date before speaking.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still 6297 lines — carry-over from iter 15; consider extracting /admin/founders/* and /voice/* into routers.

AdminFounders share_url is hardcoded to https://hiagain.xyz/invite/{code} in the backend response; if a QA or staging tester copies from preview they'll paste a prod URL. Minor UX — likely intentional since prod is where invites are meant to be used.

Morning greeting useEffect depends only on [user]; if user object identity changes on refetch it could re-run — mitigated by greetedRef.current guard + localStorage same-day check, so safe in practice.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin founders page + voice primer are green. Playwright cannot exercise real mic — primer accept path calls beginRecognition() which is skipped in headless (no getUserMedia). Morning greeting cannot be time-traveled from Playwright either; verify via code review only.
